**What would you like ShaderScope to do?**
The feature, in one or two sentences.

**Why?**
The use case. What you're trying to accomplish that doesn't work today.

**Sketch of how it might work**
UI changes, new CLI flags, config keys — whatever level of detail you
have. "I don't know how" is also a valid answer.

**Anything else?**
Links to relevant RetroArch features, similar tools, or upstream
ShaderGlass behavior.
